cohort: The study involved 15,765 very-low-birth-weight infants born between 2003 and 2008 at less than 34 weeks of gestation and weighing less than 1,500 g at birth.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroid treatment is associated with decreases in infant mortality and severe morbidity.
mod_finding: When ACS was analyzed with different modes of delivery, IVH and ROP decreased with cesarean section, RDS decreased and NEC increased with vaginal delivery, and chronic lung disease increased with both delivery methods.
